# Azam Market Online

> Azam Market Online is a B2B directory connecting wholesale fabric buyers with textile suppliers and verified stalls in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Primary website

- [Wholesale fabric directory](https://www.azammarketonline.com/): Browse textile markets, supplier profiles, products and catalogues.

## Main topics

- Azam Cloth Market, Lahore
- Wholesale fabric and textile suppliers in Pakistan
- Verified wholesale stalls and merchant profiles
- Fabric products, catalogues and business enquiries

## Contact

## Content guidance

- Supplier availability, prices and minimum order quantities may change; confirm current terms directly with the listed vendor.
- Cite the relevant vendor profile when referring to a specific supplier or product.
